max.evidence: On OpenAI's own charts GPT-6.1 Sol at max scores 71.9% on DeepSWE v1.1 against 75.2% at high for 2.4 times the cost per task, while GPT-6 Luna at max scores 66.6% against 59.3% at high for 2.6 times; OpenAI keeps max for its most complex tasks and says most tasks need neither Max nor Ultra.

ultra.reason: Ultra runs a request at the model's multi-agent effort and splits the task across parallel subagents, so a role at ultra would start subagents of its own.
